descriptionWindows: Strip down Windows — remove telemetry, bloatware, and unnecessary services
descriptionOther: Harden your system — manage privacy settings and unnecessary services

privacy.pageDescription: Reads the telemetry, advertising, search and sync settings and compares them with the most private value. A setting changes only when you use its switch or confirm; most can be set back to the default.
privacy.emptyStateDescription: The scan reads the settings and changes none of them.
privacy.adminWarning: Some settings can be changed only when SuperSonicCleaner runs as administrator; without those rights they stay as they are.
privacy.applyFailed: Could not apply the privacy settings
privacy.applyFailedDescription: Try running the app as administrator
privacy.ipcCallFailed: The call failed: try running the app as administrator
privacy.adminRequired: Try running the app as administrator
privacy.settingNotApplied: The system did not report the change: it may need a restart, or the setting is managed by another profile.
privacy.summaryNone: All {{total}} settings already have the most private value
privacy.summaryFacts: {{protected}} of {{total}} already at the most private value · {{categories}} categories
privacy.receiptReversible: can be restored from the switches
privacy.receiptFailed_one: {{count}} not applied: the reason is listed below.
privacy.receiptFailed_other: {{count}} not applied: the reasons are listed below.
privacy.receiptFailedAdmin_one: {{count}} not applied: it may need the app to run as administrator. The reason is listed below.
privacy.receiptFailedAdmin_other: {{count}} not applied: they may need the app to run as administrator. The reasons are listed below.
privacy.confirmDescription: The settings listed switch to the most private value. They can be set back to the default from the switches on this page.
privacy.confirmDescriptionIrreversible_one: The settings listed switch to the most private value. {{count}} cannot be set back to the default from this page.
privacy.confirmDescriptionIrreversible_other: The settings listed switch to the most private value. {{count}} cannot be set back to the default from this page.

telemetry-level.label: Windows telemetry
telemetry-level.description: Set diagnostic data collection to the minimum (Security level only)

activity-history.label: Activity history
activity-history.description: Stop Windows from tracking and syncing your app and file usage

publish-activity.label: Publish user activities
publish-activity.description: Prevent Windows from publishing your activities to Microsoft

feedback-frequency.label: Feedback prompts
feedback-frequency.description: Turn off the periodic Microsoft feedback prompts and surveys

handwriting-telemetry.label: Handwriting data
handwriting-telemetry.description: Stop sending handwriting and typing data to Microsoft

input-personalization.label: Input personalization
input-personalization.description: Stop collecting typing and inking data for personalization

tailored-experiences.label: Tailored experiences
tailored-experiences.description: Stop Microsoft from using diagnostic data to personalize tips and ads

app-launch-tracking.label: App launch tracking
app-launch-tracking.description: Stop Windows from tracking which apps you open to tune the Start menu

advertising-id.label: Advertising ID
advertising-id.description: Turn off the unique advertising ID that apps use to track you

suggested-content.label: Suggested content in Settings
suggested-content.description: Stop Microsoft from showing app suggestions and ads in Settings

tips-notifications.label: Tips and suggestions
tips-notifications.description: Turn off Windows tips, tricks and suggestion notifications

start-suggestions.label: Start menu suggestions
start-suggestions.description: Turn off app suggestions (ads) in the Start menu

lock-screen-spotlight.label: Lock screen Spotlight
lock-screen-spotlight.description: Turn off Microsoft Spotlight ads and suggestions on the lock screen

silently-installed-apps.label: Silently installed apps
silently-installed-apps.description: Prevent Windows from installing promoted apps automatically

preinstalled-apps.label: Pre-installed app suggestions
preinstalled-apps.description: Stop Windows from suggesting pre-installed apps you haven't used

bing-start-menu.label: Bing in the Start menu
bing-start-menu.description: Stop search queries typed in the Start menu from being sent to Bing

bing-web-search.label: Bing web results
bing-web-search.description: Turn off web results in Windows Search, so searches stay on this PC

cortana.label: Cortana
cortana.description: Turn off Cortana, which runs in the background and collects data

search-highlights.label: Search highlights
search-highlights.description: Turn off trending search suggestions and web content in the search box

store-search-suggestions.label: Store search suggestions
store-search-suggestions.description: Turn off Microsoft Store search suggestions, which send your queries to Microsoft

clipboard-sync.label: Clipboard cloud sync
clipboard-sync.description: Prevent clipboard data from being synced across devices through the cloud

clipboard-history.label: Clipboard history
clipboard-history.description: Turn off the clipboard history that stores copied text and images

settings-sync.label: Settings sync
settings-sync.description: Stop syncing Windows settings, themes and passwords to your Microsoft account

find-my-device.label: Find my device
find-my-device.description: Turn off location-based device tracking by Microsoft

copilot.label: Microsoft Copilot
copilot.description: Turn off the Microsoft Copilot AI assistant across Windows

windows-recall.label: Windows Recall
windows-recall.description: Turn off Windows Recall, the AI screenshot history that captures everything on screen

click-to-do.label: Click to Do
click-to-do.description: Turn off Click to Do AI analysis of the text and images on screen

ai-service-autostart.label: AI service auto-start
ai-service-autostart.description: Prevent AI services from starting automatically in the background

edge-ai-features.label: Edge Compose AI
edge-ai-features.description: Turn off the Edge AI text composition and rewriting features

paint-ai.label: Paint AI features
paint-ai.description: Turn off the AI image generation features in Microsoft Paint

notepad-ai.label: Notepad AI features
notepad-ai.description: Turn off the AI text rewriting features in Microsoft Notepad

service-diagtrack.label: DiagTrack service
service-diagtrack.description: Disable the Connected User Experiences and Telemetry service

service-dmwappush.label: WAP Push service
service-dmwappush.description: Disable the WAP Push message routing service used for telemetry

service-delivery-optimization.label: Delivery Optimization
service-delivery-optimization.description: Disable peer-to-peer sharing of Windows updates, so this PC does not upload update data to other devices

service-mapsbroker.label: Maps Broker
service-mapsbroker.description: Disable the Downloaded Maps Manager, a background service most PCs do not need

task-compatibility-appraiser.label: Compatibility Appraiser
task-compatibility-appraiser.description: Disable the Microsoft telemetry task that collects compatibility data

task-program-data-updater.label: Program Data Updater
task-program-data-updater.description: Disable the background task that uploads program telemetry

task-autochk-proxy.label: Autochk Proxy
task-autochk-proxy.description: Disable the telemetry collection done through the autochk proxy

task-ceip-consolidator.label: CEIP Consolidator
task-ceip-consolidator.description: Disable the Customer Experience Improvement Program data upload

task-usb-ceip.label: USB usage data (CEIP)
task-usb-ceip.description: Disable the collection of USB device usage telemetry

task-disk-diagnostic.label: Disk Diagnostic Collector
task-disk-diagnostic.description: Disable the collection and upload of disk diagnostic data

task-feedback-dm.label: Feedback DM Client
task-feedback-dm.description: Disable the feedback device management telemetry task

task-maps-update.label: Maps update task
task-maps-update.description: Disable automatic map data downloads in the background

edge-metrics.label: Edge metrics reporting
edge-metrics.description: Stop Edge from sending usage and crash metrics to Microsoft

edge-site-info.label: Edge site info collection
edge-site-info.description: Stop Edge from sending the addresses of the sites you visit to Microsoft

edge-personalization.label: Edge personalization reporting
edge-personalization.description: Stop Edge from sending your browsing history for ad personalization

edge-copilot-cdp.label: Edge Copilot page access (CDP)
edge-copilot-cdp.description: Prevent Copilot from reading page content through the Chrome DevTools Protocol

edge-copilot-page.label: Edge Copilot page context
edge-copilot-page.description: Prevent Copilot from using the page context to analyse content

edge-discover.label: Edge Discover page scanning
edge-discover.description: Stop the Discover feature from scanning page content

edge-sidebar.label: Edge sidebar
edge-sidebar.description: Turn off the Edge sidebar and its background data collection

edge-shopping.label: Edge shopping assistant
edge-shopping.description: Turn off the price comparison tracker in Edge

chrome-metrics.label: Chrome metrics reporting
chrome-metrics.description: Stop Chrome from sending usage and crash metrics to Google

chrome-feedback.label: Chrome user feedback
chrome-feedback.description: Prevent Chrome from collecting and sending user feedback data

chrome-extended-reporting.label: Chrome extended Safe Browsing
chrome-extended-reporting.description: Stop Chrome from sending extended URL and download reports to Google

firefox-telemetry.label: Firefox telemetry
firefox-telemetry.description: Stop Firefox from collecting telemetry data and uploading it to Mozilla

firefox-default-agent.label: Firefox default browser agent
firefox-default-agent.description: Disable the background agent that reports browser usage data to Mozilla

macos-diagnostics.label: Diagnostics and usage data
macos-diagnostics.description: Stop sharing diagnostic and usage data with Apple

macos-siri-analytics.label: Siri analytics
macos-siri-analytics.description: Stop Siri analytics and improvement data collection

macos-health-data-sharing.label: Health data sharing
macos-health-data-sharing.description: Stop sharing health data with Apple for research

macos-airdrop-discoverability.label: AirDrop discoverability
macos-airdrop-discoverability.description: Set AirDrop to No One: you cannot receive files through AirDrop until you turn it back on in System Settings

macos-crash-reporter.label: Crash reporter
macos-crash-reporter.description: Stop the crash reporter from sending reports automatically

macos-siri-suggestions-appstore.label: Siri suggestions in the App Store
macos-siri-suggestions-appstore.description: Turn off Siri suggestions in the App Store

macos-safari-suggestions.label: Safari suggestions
macos-safari-suggestions.description: Turn off the Safari search suggestions sent to Apple

macos-safari-preload-top-hit.label: Safari preload top hit
macos-safari-preload-top-hit.description: Stop Safari from preloading the top search hit, which sends browsing data to sites

macos-handoff.label: Handoff
macos-handoff.description: Turn off Handoff and Universal Clipboard: you can no longer continue activities or copy and paste between Apple devices

macos-icloud-analytics.label: iCloud analytics
macos-icloud-analytics.description: Stop sharing iCloud analytics with Apple

macos-safari-cloud-tabs.label: Safari iCloud tabs
macos-safari-cloud-tabs.description: Turn off Safari iCloud tab syncing: you no longer see the tabs open on your other Apple devices

macos-siri-enabled.label: Siri
macos-siri-enabled.description: Turn off Siri entirely: Hey Siri, voice commands and Siri Shortcuts stop working

macos-siri-dictation.label: Siri dictation
macos-siri-dictation.description: Turn off dictation: the microphone key on your keyboard stops working

macos-apple-intelligence.label: Apple Intelligence
macos-apple-intelligence.description: Turn off the Apple Intelligence AI features (macOS 15 Sequoia and later)

macos-safari-dnt.label: Safari Do Not Track
macos-safari-dnt.description: Turn on the Do Not Track header in Safari

macos-chrome-metrics.label: Chrome metrics reporting
macos-chrome-metrics.description: Stop Chrome from sending usage metrics to Google

macos-chrome-safe-browsing.label: Chrome Safe Browsing reports
macos-chrome-safe-browsing.description: Stop Chrome from sending extended URL and download reports to Google

macos-firefox-telemetry.label: Firefox telemetry
macos-firefox-telemetry.description: Stop Firefox from collecting telemetry data and uploading it to Mozilla

macos-gatekeeper.label: Gatekeeper
macos-gatekeeper.description: Make sure Gatekeeper is on, so unverified applications are blocked

macos-remote-apple-events.label: Remote Apple Events
macos-remote-apple-events.description: Turn off remote Apple Events, so your Mac cannot be automated remotely

macos-wake-on-network.label: Wake for network access
macos-wake-on-network.description: Turn off wake for network access, so your Mac cannot be woken remotely

macos-guest-account.label: Guest account
macos-guest-account.description: Turn off the guest account to prevent unauthorized local access

macos-auto-login.label: Automatic login
macos-auto-login.description: Turn off automatic login, so the Mac asks for authentication at startup

macos-firewall.label: Application firewall
macos-firewall.description: Turn on the macOS application firewall to control incoming connections

macos-stealth-mode.label: Stealth mode
macos-stealth-mode.description: Turn on stealth mode, so your Mac does not answer probe requests (ICMP ping)

macos-ip-forwarding.label: Disable IP forwarding
macos-ip-forwarding.description: Prevent the system from forwarding packets between network interfaces

macos-block-signed-auto.label: Block automatic allowance for signed apps
macos-block-signed-auto.description: Prevent signed applications from bypassing the firewall automatically

macos-remote-login.label: Disable remote login (SSH)
macos-remote-login.description: Turn off the SSH server entirely. If you need SSH access, leave this off and harden the SSH settings instead

macos-ssh-root-login.label: Disable SSH root login
macos-ssh-root-login.description: Prevent direct root login over SSH; use sudo from a regular account instead

macos-ssh-password-auth.label: Disable SSH password authentication
macos-ssh-password-auth.description: Allow only key-based SSH authentication. Set up SSH keys first, or you may be locked out

macos-core-dumps.label: Disable core dumps
macos-core-dumps.description: Prevent core dumps, which can leak sensitive memory contents

gnome-usage-stats.label: Usage statistics
gnome-usage-stats.description: Turn off GNOME usage statistics collection

gnome-recent-files.label: Recent files tracking
gnome-recent-files.description: Turn off the tracking of recently used files

gnome-crash-reporting.label: Crash reporting (Apport)
gnome-crash-reporting.description: Turn off automatic crash report submission

gnome-connectivity-check.label: Connectivity check
gnome-connectivity-check.description: Turn off the periodic network connectivity checks

core-dump-disable.label: Disable core dumps
core-dump-disable.description: Prevent core dumps, which can leak sensitive memory contents

ssh-root-login.label: Disable SSH root login
ssh-root-login.description: Prevent direct root login over SSH; use sudo from a regular account instead

ssh-password-auth.label: Disable SSH password authentication
ssh-password-auth.description: Allow only key-based SSH authentication. Set up SSH keys first, or you may be locked out

kde-usage-stats.label: Usage statistics
kde-usage-stats.description: Turn off KDE Plasma user feedback

kde-recent-files.label: Recent files tracking
kde-recent-files.description: Turn off the KDE activity history of recent files

kde-baloo.label: File indexing (Baloo)
kde-baloo.description: Turn off the Baloo file indexer

kde-crash-reporting.label: Crash reporting (DrKonqi)
kde-crash-reporting.description: Turn off the KDE crash report handler

privacyCategories.telemetryDescription: Control diagnostic and usage data collection
privacyCategories.adsDescription: Block promoted apps, ad suggestions, and lock screen spotlight
privacyCategories.searchDescription: Keep searches local and disable web-based search features
privacyCategories.syncDescription: Control clipboard syncing, settings sync, and device tracking
privacyCategories.servicesDescription: Disable background services that collect and upload telemetry
privacyCategories.tasksDescription: Disable telemetry scheduled tasks running in the background
privacyCategories.kernelDescription: Kernel security parameters and memory protection via sysctl
privacyCategories.networkDescription: Network stack hardening and traffic filtering via sysctl
privacyCategories.accessDescription: Access control policies, SSH hardening, and system restrictions
privacyCategories.aiDescription: Disable Copilot, Recall, and other AI features that analyze your data
privacyCategories.browserDescription: Stop browsers from reporting usage data to Microsoft, Google, and Mozilla

debloater.pageDescription: Apps pre-installed by Windows and the manufacturer. Once removed, they can only be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store.
debloater.irreversibleWarning: Removal cannot be undone from the app: check the selected apps before you confirm.
debloater.reinstallFromStore: reinstallable only from the Microsoft Store
debloater.emptyStateDescription: No scan of pre-installed apps in this session.
debloater.checkKnownDetail: A list of apps pre-installed by Microsoft and by manufacturers (OEM)
debloater.checkInstalledDetail: Your user's app packages, compared with the list
debloater.checkRemovalDetail: For your user; with administrator rights also from the copy used for new users
debloater.noneFoundTitle: None of the listed apps is installed
debloater.noneFoundDescription: The known pre-installed apps are not present for your user.
debloater.confirmDescription_one: The app is removed for your user and, with administrator rights, for new users too. It can only be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store.
debloater.confirmDescription_other: The apps are removed for your user and, with administrator rights, for new users too. They can only be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store.
debloater.scanFailedError: Failed to scan for bloatware. Make sure PowerShell is available.
debloater.removeFailedError: Failed to remove some apps. Administrator privileges may be required.

serviceManager.pageDescription: Lists Windows services with their startup type and status and rates how safe each is to disable. Disabling or re-enabling a service changes its startup type: it asks for confirmation and administrator rights and can be undone from the Recovery Centre.
serviceManager.progressOneRequest: One request to Windows; it can take a few seconds.
serviceManager.receiptReversible: can be undone from the Recovery Centre
serviceManager.emptyStateDescription: The scan reads the list from Windows and changes nothing.
serviceManager.checkStartDetail: For every installed service, read from Windows.
serviceManager.checkSafetyDetail: Compared with a built-in list of known services: safe to disable, use caution or system-critical.
serviceManager.checkDepsDetail: Which services depend on each one.
serviceManager.summaryReEnableHint: Select a disabled service to re-enable it.
serviceManager.confirmDescription: The startup type becomes Disabled and running services are stopped. Administrator rights are required; you can undo this from the Recovery Centre.
serviceManager.confirmEnableDescription: The startup type goes back to {{startType}}; automatic services start right away. Administrator rights are required.
